top_signals.title: Asian Bonds to Decline as Oil Fans Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian bonds looked set to track Treasuries lower as the US-Iran standoff kept oil prices elevated, adding to inflation concerns and bets on further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
